decisions.choice: Full immutable native observation admitted at capture and delivery, correlated to one owner snapshot and preview handle. No web DTO trust booleans; typed records are synthetic premises here. Existing input/output public schemas remain unchanged. Exact internal observation API/port placement pending Owner; no new public Port silently approved.

One preview mutation fence per owner binding with generation/root epoch token; verify native authority and owner revision at linearization before publish/replace/mock commit. Snapshot→validate→recheck→commit under adopted fence, no check/use gap. Begin capacity 4; refresh atomically exchanges one slot even at capacity; close retires exactly once. Epoch changes invalidate observations. Fence implementation and lock/await ordering require architecture approval.

Refresh failure before exchange preserves old handle/mock/slot while disabling actions (stale=true,can_act=false); successful exchange retires old handle, resets new sequence=1 and detached mock. Unknown provider outcome cannot promise rollback. Close unknown after commit stays CloseUncertain, no retry, no false Closed; committed retirement remains. Late response never reinstalls old root or UI state.

Full identity guard precedence: malformed→DependencyNotReady; dead/revoked→PreviewClosed; consumer/window→UnauthorizedCaller; project/root/epoch/document/session→MissingBinding; generation→StaleOwner; handle→PreviewClosed. Revision uses existing exact bounded u64 string errors and is not reconstructed from generation. Proposed precedence requires Owner confirmation, not source-derived authority.

admission_parity: Schema validates tuple grammar only; well-typed mismatches/live/revoked still yield existing semantic admission errors; only malformed parity is claimed.
